{
  "decision-isolate-trading-working-capital": "WITH changes AS (
  SELECT b.balance_id, b.balance_side,
         b.closing_cents - b.opening_cents - COALESCE(SUM(m.movement_cents), 0) AS trading_change_cents
  FROM depot_balance AS b
  LEFT JOIN depot_move AS m ON m.balance_id = b.balance_id AND m.move_kind IN ('acquired', 'translation')
  GROUP BY b.balance_id, b.balance_side, b.opening_cents, b.closing_cents
)
SELECT balance_id, trading_change_cents,
       CASE balance_side WHEN 'asset' THEN -trading_change_cents ELSE trading_change_cents END AS operating_adjustment_cents
FROM changes
ORDER BY balance_id ASC",
  "decision-join-split-page-caption": "SELECT DISTINCT (l.piece || r.piece) COLLATE BINARY AS caption
FROM job AS j
JOIN fragment AS l ON l.impression = j.impression AND l.side = 'L' AND l.lo = 4
JOIN fragment AS r ON r.impression = j.impression AND r.side = 'R' AND r.lo = l.hi AND r.hi = 12
ORDER BY caption COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-kiln-cart-dispatch": "WITH loads(departure_no, first_batch, second_batch, load_kg, saved_cents, batch_count) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT departure_no, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0 FROM kiln_offer
  UNION ALL
  SELECT departure_no, batch_code, NULL, mass_kg, delay_cents, 1
  FROM kiln_offer WHERE mass_kg <= 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.departure_no, a.batch_code, b.batch_code, a.mass_kg + b.mass_kg, a.delay_cents + b.delay_cents, 2
  FROM kiln_offer AS a
  JOIN kiln_offer AS b ON b.departure_no = a.departure_no AND a.batch_code COLLATE BINARY < b.batch_code
  WHERE a.mass_kg + b.mass_kg <= 10
), ranked AS (
  SELECT loads.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY departure_no
    ORDER BY saved_cents DESC, load_kg, batch_count, first_batch COLLATE BINARY, second_batch COLLATE BINARY
  ) AS choice
  FROM loads
)
SELECT departure_no, first_batch, second_batch, load_kg, saved_cents
FROM ranked WHERE choice = 1
ORDER BY departure_no",
  "decision-kiln-disagreement-by-exposure-time": "WITH intervals AS (
  SELECT kiln_code, left_c, right_c, tick_min,
         LEAD(tick_min, 1, 20) OVER (PARTITION BY kiln_code ORDER BY tick_min) AS end_min
  FROM probe_pairs
), exposure AS (
  SELECT kiln_code, left_c, right_c,
         CASE WHEN left_c IS NOT NULL AND right_c IS NOT NULL
              THEN MAX(0, MIN(20, end_min) - MAX(0, tick_min)) ELSE 0 END AS minutes
  FROM intervals
)
SELECT kiln_code, SUM(minutes) AS covered_minutes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(left_c - right_c) >= 5 THEN minutes ELSE 0 END) AS discordant_minutes
FROM exposure
GROUP BY kiln_code
ORDER BY kiln_code"
}
